# Freelancer

> > Global freelance marketplace connecting businesses with skilled professionals across web development, mobile apps, and technical troubleshooting.

Freelancer is a platform where clients post projects and freelancers bid on jobs spanning technologies like FastAPI, Next.js, Node.js, Python, iOS, Android, WordPress, and more. The site includes extensive job search pages for specific technical challenges and error resolution across various frameworks and platforms.

## Key Topics

- Freelance Jobs
- Web Development
- Full-Stack Development
- Mobile Development (iOS, Android)
- FastAPI
- Next.js
- Node.js
- Python
- WordPress
- CodeIgniter
- Error Debugging
- Plugin Development
- RSS Feeds
- SaaS Development
- Server-Side Troubleshooting

## Web Development & Framework Jobs

- [Client Side Error and Server Side Error Jobs](https://www.br.freelancer.com/job-search/client-side-error-and-server-side-error/): Job search for client/server-side error debugging with FastAPI/Next.js
- [List Full Text RSS Feeds Jobs](https://www.br.freelancer.com/job-search/list-full-text-rss-feeds/): Job search page for RSS feed development with FastAPI/Next.js/Node.js
- [CodeIgniter URL Not Found Error Jobs](https://www.br.freelancer.com/job-search/object-not-found-the-requested-url-was-not-found-on-this-server-codeigniter/32/): Job search for CodeIgniter URL/server error troubleshooting

## CMS & Plugin Development Jobs

- [Plugin Archetype Error Jobs](https://www.br.freelancer.com/job-search/no-plugin-found-for-prefix-archetype-in-the-current-project-and-in-the-plugin-groups/): Job search page for WordPress/Prestashop plugin archetype errors

## Database & Server Error Resolution

- [SQL Server Login Error 0x80131904 Jobs](https://www.br.freelancer.com/job-search/failed-to-execute-is-server-package-because-of-error-0x80131904-login-failed/181/): Job search for SQL Server login error 0x80131904 resolution
